sourceCommit.message:
Add native collections and shared media context actions (#23)

Collections currently share the playlist model and appear in the
playlist screen. Add Movies discovery, dedicated poster pages, movie
membership links, mixed-media browsing, and sorting. Collection-specific
provider APIs and session state support online, permission-aware
creation, metadata/artwork edits, membership changes, and safe deletion.
This unreleased collection implementation includes no migration layer.

Integrate shared media context menus with scoped group removal, Next Up
actions, and explicit watched/unwatched resets. Preserve aligned
progress bars and acknowledged zero-position checkpoints.

Validation:

- Six platform builds passed with zero diagnostics; iOS 442, macOS 439,
tvOS 440, and visionOS 439 unit tests passed without failures or skips.
- Both final iPhone UI regressions passed, including collection
CRUD/membership navigation and Next Up/context actions with independent
Jellyfin readbacks.
- Live demo checks verified metadata, artwork, multiple memberships, and
deletion preserving members and playback state. Static checks and all
three website tests passed.
- Saved evidence and screenshots:
`Documentation/Reviews/2026-10-13-collections/`.

Companion wiki/support updates are prepared locally. Physical-device and
broader platform accessibility acceptance remain open. No deployment or
distribution occurred.
